eq_why_us.prompt: So. Why do you want to work here?

answers.text: {insider}
answers.reaction: ...You actually read about us. That's rarer than you'd think.

answers.text: Honestly? Rent.
answers.reaction: Fair. Relatable. Not an answer, but fair.

answers.text: What do you do again?
answers.reaction: We have a website. It has an About page. It's right there.

eq_friday_deploy.prompt: Friday, 4:55 PM. Your app update is done, but nobody has tested it yet. What do you do?

answers.text: Test it, then release it on Monday.
answers.reaction: Correct. Weekends are for sleeping, not for fixing Friday's surprises.

answers.text: Ask the team chat what to do.
answers.reaction: Safe-ish. The team chat says 'Looks good!' to everything. It said it to a blank page once.

answers.text: Release it now. Turn off my phone.
answers.reaction: Bold. That's exactly how our last three weekends got cancelled.

eq_credit_theft.prompt: Your teammate Jordan fixed the big bug. In the meeting, your manager thanks YOU.

answers.text: Say it was Jordan's fix, not mine.
answers.reaction: Correct. Steal credit once and your whole team starts keeping receipts.

answers.text: Say nothing, thank Jordan later.
answers.reaction: Half credit. Jordan noticed. Jordan remembers.

answers.text: 'Thanks, it was really hard.'
answers.reaction: Jordan is in this meeting. Jordan is looking at you.

exclusive.text: At my internship we shared credit.
exclusive.reaction: You mention the internship a lot. Correct answer, though.

eq_outage_blame.prompt: Your update broke the site's Pay button for 10 minutes. Tomorrow the team reviews what went wrong.

answers.text: Own it, explain it, prevent it.
answers.reaction: Perfect. That meeting is for fixing the process, not the person. The process is in trouble.

answers.text: Say it was 'a settings issue'.
answers.reaction: True. And who changed the settings? (You. It was you.)

answers.text: Blame the intern.
answers.reaction: We don't have an intern. We have you.

eq_ai_takehome.prompt: Honest question: did you use an AI assistant on our at-home coding test?

answers.text: Yes, and I can explain every line.
answers.reaction: Great. We allow tools. We don't allow mysteries.

answers.text: A little. Mostly for vibes.
answers.reaction: 'Vibes' won't help when I ask what line 12 does. Close, though.

answers.text: Never. What's an AI?
answers.reaction: The screen you're sharing shows Guessomatic, the AI app. Open. Right now.

eq_leaked_password.prompt: Someone posted the password to all our customer data in the company-wide group chat.

answers.text: Tell security so they change it.
answers.reaction: Exactly. Once a password leaks, it isn't a password anymore. It's trivia.

answers.text: Delete the message and move on.
answers.reaction: Deleting it doesn't change it. Half the company already saw it. Some took screenshots.

answers.text: Screenshot it. Might be handy.
answers.reaction: Please stay seated. Legal is walking over.

eq_celebrity_orders.prompt: A coworker dares you to look up a celebrity customer's order history.

answers.text: No. No business reason, no access.
answers.reaction: Correct. Also, every look-up is recorded. Every single one.

answers.text: Only if we hide the name first.
answers.reaction: Nice try. Hiding the name doesn't make it your business.

answers.text: Sure, in incognito mode.
answers.reaction: Private mode hides it from your browser history. Not from our security team.

eq_meeting_overload.prompt: Six hours of meetings today. Your deadline is tomorrow.

answers.text: Skip the optional ones, ask for notes.
answers.reaction: Healthy boundaries! Rare here, but healthy.

answers.text: Attend all, camera off, work quietly.
answers.reaction: Relatable. Our nod-detection AI flagged you anyway.

answers.text: Book a meeting about fewer meetings.
answers.reaction: Accepted. It's recurring now. Weekly.

eq_impossible_deadline.prompt: Your boss wants a 3-month project done by Friday. It's Wednesday.

answers.text: Offer a smaller version and flag risks.
answers.reaction: A smaller plan and the risks, in writing. Someone's been burned before.

answers.text: Say yes and hope.
answers.reaction: Hope is not a plan. We know. We tried it last quarter.

answers.text: Put up a 'Coming Soon' sign.
answers.reaction: ...That's literally our five-year plan.

exclusive.text: My course says: do less, warn early.

eq_harsh_review.prompt: A senior coworker checks your work and leaves one comment: 'this is garbage'.

answers.text: Ask what to fix; discuss tone privately.
answers.reaction: Mature. And yes, raise it. 'Garbage' isn't feedback.

answers.text: Fix it silently and seethe.
answers.reaction: Fixed code, unfixed feelings. Half marks.

answers.text: Reply: 'I know you are, but what am I?'
answers.reaction: A playground classic. Not a career move.

exclusive.text: So far, only an AI app reviews my work.
exclusive.reaction: Honest. Help out on free, public coding projects: real humans review your work there.

answers.text: I overdo details, so I set time limits.
answers.reaction: A real answer! I'm writing that down in pen.

answers.text: I'm a perfectionist who works too hard.
answers.reaction: That's the 3,000th time I've heard that. Second today.

answers.text: Garlic. And sunlight.
answers.reaction: ...Okay. We do have a night shift.

eq_grind_culture.prompt: We work 80-hour weeks here. Grind culture. You in?

answers.text: Committed, but at a sustainable pace.
answers.reaction: Most people just say yes. You didn't. That's... reassuring, actually.

answers.text: Is the pay 80 hours' worth too?
answers.reaction: Great question. Next question.

answers.text: I'll sleep under my desk.
answers.reaction: Love the energy. Our insurance does not.

eq_rto.prompt: Five days in the office, starting Monday. Thoughts?

answers.text: I'd ask why, then plan around it.
answers.reaction: A mature answer. I'm almost suspicious.

answers.text: Is it negotiable?
answers.reaction: Everything is negotiable. Except this.

answers.text: Swipe in, grab a free coffee, go home.
answers.reaction: Ah, 'coffee badging'. It's so common it has a name. Our door scanners keep score.

eq_any_questions.prompt: Do you have any questions for us?

answers.text: What does success look like in 90 days?
answers.reaction: Oh, a good question. Let me actually think.

answers.text: How soon can I take vacation?
answers.reaction: Day 91. After probation. Noted.

answers.text: No, I'm good.
answers.reaction: Not having questions is also an answer.
